title: Code Autopsy Invariant
description: Single architecture/contract policy rule evaluated deterministically by the invariant engine. Validated before evaluation; invalid rules fail with location diagnostics.

id.description: Stable rule identifier (uppercase alphanumeric, dash, underscore). Referenced by findings, evidence, and baseline waivers.

description.description: Human-readable rule intent, surfaced in reports and PR comments.

kind.description: Evaluator kind: forbidden_dependency (alias forbidden-dep), layers, no_new_cycle (alias no-new-cycle), or api_compatibility (alias api-compat). Unknown kinds fail evaluation explicitly.

severity.description: Failure severity attached to findings from this rule.

scope.description: Optional glob scope constraining the rule (source/target path patterns).

rule.description: Optional kind-specific rule parameters (thresholds, layer maps, dependency pairs).
